text.title: ADA Title II Compliance 2026 Procedure
text.summary: 7-step procedure to apply the methodology end-to-end. Six-step workflow from digital inventory to conformance documentation, with agent responsibilities and human checkpoints.

step.name: scope-services
step.action: List every public-facing URL/app/kiosk; exclude internal-only systems.

step.name: run-audit
step.decision-gate: If audit incomplete by 30 days pre-deadline, escalate to leadership.

step.name: gap-analysis
step.action: Map each finding to remediation cost + ETA; flag findings that cannot complete by deadline.

step.name: implement-fixes
step.action: Work the roadmap highest-priority first: Add captions to all video content; provide audio descriptions for visual-only information. Tag all PDFs with proper heading structure, alt text, and reading order. Ensure all forms have programmatic labels, error identification, and error suggestions. Verify keyboard navigation order, focus visibility, and skip-nav links.

step.name: ongoing-monitoring
step.action: Wire automated accessibility checks into CI/CD (ci-accessibility-checks); schedule periodic re-crawls of the inventory for new surfaces.

step.name: emit-conformance-report
step.action: Render templates/conformance-report.md + JSON; produce the VPAT 2.5 INT / ACR per covered product. Human checkpoints: Legal counsel must review and sign VPAT/ACR conformance statements. Manual AT (assistive technology) walkthroughs by a qualified evaluator are required for captions, audio descriptions, and complex form interactions. Validation with real AT users (screen reader, voice control, switch access) before declaring compliance.
step.decision-gate: No conformance claim leaves without legal counsel sign-off (vpat-acr-legal-signoff).
